# niubigeo-async

> Official architecture documentation and production specifications for niubigeo-async

## Documentation

- [Home](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/index.html)
- [Documentation Catalog](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/index.html)
- [NiubiGEO 开源产品架构](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/ARCHITECTURE.html): 适用对象：本仓库 src/product 中的 NiubiGEO Community Edition。当前公开版本为 v0.2.0，发布内容与已知限制见 正式版本说明，部署入口见 Docker 部署。本页说明开源产品的模块、数据和执行边界，不是官方商业平台的系统架构。
- [NiubiGEO 审计执行边界设计](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/AUDIT_EXECUTION_BOUNDARY.html): NiubiGEO 的正式审计只承担三件事：
- [Brand Question Taxonomy](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/BRAND_QUESTION_TAXONOMY.html): NiubiGEO classifies only questions that directly concern the product or service represented by the submitted domain. The Provider perform...
- [Capability Matrix](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/CAPABILITY_MATRIX.html): This document is the implementation contract for NiubiGEO Community Edition.
- [NiubiGEO Chart Meaning System](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/CHART_MEANING_SYSTEM.html): Every chart must answer one user question before it displays data.
- [Delivery Discipline](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/DELIVERY_DISCIPLINE.html): This document is the mandatory delivery contract for every NiubiGEO change.
- [Intent Result Layer](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/INTENT_RESULT_LAYER.html): NiubiGEO's domain audit flow stays unchanged:
- [Keyword Audit Architecture](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/KEYWORD_AUDIT_ARCHITECTURE.html): Keyword audit is the layer that prevents NiubiGEO from only asking about a raw domain.
- [NiubiGEO Long-Term Monitoring Architecture](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/LONG_TERM_MONITORING_ARCHITECTURE.html): NiubiGEO is moving from isolated audit reports to a long-running monitoring platform.
- [Model Web Search Capabilities](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/MODEL_WEB_SEARCH_CAPABILITIES.html): NiubiGEO exposes native web-search capability per model, never as a provider-wide promise.
- [NiubiGEO Motion Design System](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/MOTION_DESIGN_SYSTEM.html): Motion in NiubiGEO communicates state, progress, evidence, and failure. It must never invent activity or hide incomplete data.
- [Provider-Native Web Search](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/NATIVE_WEB_SEARCH.html): NiubiGEO treats web search as an explicit execution capability, not as a generic retrieval fallback.
- [NiubiGEO Open Source Alpha Plan](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/OPEN_SOURCE_ALPHA.html): This document tracks what must be true before publishing NiubiGEO Community Edition as a public alpha repository.
- [Phase 5 Measurement Architecture](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/PHASE5_MEASUREMENT_ARCHITECTURE.html): Phase 5 measures two independent observation protocols.
- [Open the GEO reporting black box. Put evidence in your hands.](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/PRODUCT-GUIDE.html): Does AI know your product? How does it describe you? Who appears when nobody names your brand?
- [打破黑盒 GEO，将证据还给用户。](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/PRODUCT-GUIDE.zh-CN.html): AI 是否认识你的产品？它如何描述你？没有点名品牌时，谁会出现在答案里？
- [Provider-Native Web Search](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/PROVIDER_NATIVE_SEARCH.html): NiubiGEO treats web access as a Provider execution concern, not as a report decoration.
- [Provider 原生联网搜索](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/PROVIDER_NATIVE_SEARCH.zh-CN.html): NiubiGEO 把联网能力放在 Provider 执行层，而不是报告展示层。
- [Release layout](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/RELEASE_LAYOUT.html): This repository separates the open-source product from local validation output.
- [NiubiGEO Report Standard](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/REPORT_STANDARD.html): This document defines the user-facing report contract for NiubiGEO Community Edition.
- [UI Design](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/UI_DESIGN.html): This document defines the first public UI for NiubiGEO Community Edition.
- [NiubiGEO Workbench V2 Product and Technical Architecture](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/WORKBENCH_V2_ARCHITECTURE.html): NiubiGEO is not a collection of database tables and charts. It is a monitoring product that must let a user understand, within ten seconds:
- [品牌与文档视觉规范](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/brand.html): 适用：Phase 6 文档、官网和候选产品，计划版本 v0.2.0-rc.1，UNPUBLISHED。本页规定当前新品牌资源的用法，不代表深浅主题、浏览器截图或候选镜像资源已经验收。
- [证据模型与来源规则](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/evidence-model.html): 适用：当前产品实现，拟发布 v0.2.0-rc.1，UNPUBLISHED。本页定义如何阅读已保存记录，并指出尚未实现的保障。本轮 R02 案例 保留实际部分完成与原文；R04 案例 的联网 K 响应包含可追溯至结构化 Payload 路径的 Provider 引用。没有引...
- [工作原理：从域名到证据](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/how-it-works.html): 适用于当前 src/product 实现；计划版本 v0.2.0-rc.1，UNPUBLISHED。本文说明产品怎样取得和处理回答，不代表 Phase 6 的真实调用、截图或发布验收已经完成。
- [已知问题 / Known Issues](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/known-issues.html): 状态：未修复，发布仍为 blocked / Unresolved; release remains blocked.
- [已知限制与待验证项](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/limitations.html): 适用：2026-09-08 核对的当前 src/product 工作树，计划版本 v0.2.0-rc.1，UNPUBLISHED。以下是源码行为与缺口，不代表已执行回归测试或容器验收。后续修复应附相应验证，再更新适用范围。
- [测量方法与指标定义](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/measurement-methodology.html): 实测发现 R06、R07、R10、R11、R19 共 7 项唯一第一名冲突。相关排名及依赖该字段的汇总暂不用于比较，见 逐项证据。本轮只披露、不修改原值或算法；算术能重算不等于语义判断正确。
- [niubigeo-mirror-479 核心通信协议与数据同步技术规范](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/niubigeo-async/docs/specifications.html): - 传输层默认启用 TLS 1.3 协议通道与 AES-256 加密。
